confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from web search results. Numbeo's October 2026 lira data was the main source: inexpensive meal about TRY 500, mid-range meal for two about TRY 2,150, cappuccino about TRY 177 and domestic draft beer about TRY 150. A 2026 local Marmaris guide gave cocktails at about TRY 350-600 and wine by the glass at about TRY 180-300. I converted lira to USD at about 45 TRY per USD, an estimate from my own knowledge for mid-2026 that I did not search for, so that rate is a major source of uncertainty given Turkish inflation. I raised beer slightly because tourist-area bars and beach clubs charge more (TRY 200-250). The cocktail figure is the midpoint of the local guide's range; the wine figure is the more recent local-wine price. Other sources disagree with each other, and some are older. Accommodation anchors are my own estimates for July peak season, when a resort town's prices are high. I did not check live listings, and Marmaris has few registered hostels, so the hostel anchors are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Numbeo's Marmaris data and local Marmaris price guides, checked against other Turkish Aegean and Mediterranean resorts such as Bodrum, Fethiye and Kusadasi. Peak summer prices are above the national average.
